keyEvents.text: Goal! Portsmouth 1, West Ham United 0. Odin Bailey (Portsmouth) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
First Half ends, Portsmouth 1, West Ham United 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Ryan Kavuma-McQueen (Portsmouth).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Ebou Adams (Portsmouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, West Ham United. Tomás Soucek replaces Joël Veltman.
Substitution, West Ham United. Edvin Austbø replaces Joël Piroe.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Marlon Pack replaces Iyad Mohamed.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Abu Kamara replaces Thomas Waddingham.
Tyrese Shade (Portsmouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, West Ham United. Divine Mukasa replaces Manor Solomon.
Substitution, West Ham United. Soungoutou Magassa replaces Edson Álvarez.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Adrian Segecic replaces Odin Bailey.
Substitution, West Ham United. Valentín Castellanos replaces Mohamadou Kanté.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Conor Shaughnessy replaces Ryan Kavuma-McQueen.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Josh Murphy replaces Tyrese Shade.
Delay in match because of an injury Tomás Soucek (West Ham United).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
